scope: CFL mathematical contracts, selected worked examples, preprocessing, and REG worked grammar

GS.read: Definitions, Lemmas 2.1-2.2 and Theorem 2.1, printed pp.289-291; printed p.289 also rendered and visually inspected

EGKL.read: Introduction and Theorem 1.1; not all proof dependencies
EGKL.type: primary constructive proof of Parikh theorem

Pasti.read: Construction Figure 2, Theorem 1, Corollary 1, PDF p.5; Boolean-semiring specialization used

MathlibRegex.read: Regex constructors, semantics and automaton conversion declarations

Ramos.read: Local PDF: cfl definition and pumping_lemma statement, p.7

Hoogeboom.read: Ogden PDF p.110; interchange p.116 and worked example p.119

assertions.statement: For S→SaSb|ε|A, A→bb|aa|bSb, L∩a*b*={a^m b^k:m≡k mod2,m≤3k+2}, hence nonregular
assertions.evidence: Induction for count invariant and converse construction; infinite Nerode family in THEORY.md §0
assertions.issue: Old finite enumeration was insufficient by itself; prompt incorrectly used CFL pumping window for REG proof

assertions.statement: CFL pumping: exists p, forall sufficiently long z, exists decomposition, forall exponents
assertions.hypotheses: Nonempty combined pumped factors; short middle window anywhere in word
assertions.evidence: Ramos p.7 and explicit quantifiers in THEORY_REFERENCE.md#cfl

assertions.statement: Ogden bounds marked positions, not total middle-window length
assertions.hypotheses: At least p marked positions; pumped factors contain a mark

assertions.statement: Interchange guarantees |Z|≥|R|/(c(n+1)^2); any proved smaller upper bound gives contradiction
assertions.hypotheses: n≥m≥2, equal prefix/suffix lengths, m/2<block length≤m; not restricted to exponential R or large alphabets
assertions.evidence: Hoogeboom p.116; local context-count and rounding explanation
assertions.issue: JSON schema and later instructions still imposed false exponential-density requirement; example confused block values with whole-word count and rounded strictly

assertions.statement: CFL closed under REG intersection and usual CFL operations; arbitrary subset containment is not a negative criterion
assertions.hypotheses: Exact transformed language, both inclusion directions; correct epsilon handling
assertions.evidence: Pasti Theorem 1/Corollary 1 for intersection; Ramos for basic grammar operations; local standard constructions listed separately

assertions.statement: Signed modular sums are regular; mixed-sign threshold sums need not be
assertions.hypotheses: Fixed positive modulus; nonnegative coefficients for saturation argument
assertions.evidence: Local DFA construction and Nerode counterexample #a−#b≥0
assertions.issue: Classifier called every linear-combination threshold regular

assertions.statement: Nonregularity does not propagate through union/intersection
assertions.issue: Recursive filter analyzer returned false if any operand was nonregular

assertions.statement: Identical counts, absent symbols, length versus a letter count and malformed modular predicates require separate handling
assertions.hypotheses: Whole-word variable w and known alphabet; valid supported expression and positive integer modulus
assertions.evidence: 40 preprocessing/filter tests in initial targeted run
assertions.issue: All count comparisons were called nonregular; any modulus key certified regularity

assertions.statement: Hypothesis and preprocessing share one filter classifier; bare labels/flags do not prove regularity
assertions.issue: Duplicate heuristic trusted is_regular flag and arbitrary lhs/rhs strings; nested occurrences were called crossed

assertions.statement: Every CFL has semilinear Parikh image; converse false
assertions.hypotheses: Image of entire language, not sampled subset
assertions.evidence: EGKL Theorem 1.1; a^n b^n c^n local counterexample to converse

assertions.statement: Any finite vector set is semilinear; its observed growth cannot decide the full image
assertions.hypotheses: Finite sample; full-language conclusion only with exact theorem/certificate
assertions.evidence: Finite singleton-union proof; CFG S→ε|a|a^4|a^9 refutes old heuristic
assertions.issue: Quadratic finite sample yielded non_semilinear and non_cfl conclusion

assertions.statement: A letter-bounded language is CFL iff its exponent set has a finite stratified-linear representation
assertions.hypotheses: Distinct ordered letters, exact full exponent set, existence of some representation
assertions.evidence: GS Theorem 2.1; reduction for word bounds by inverse homomorphism and REG intersection

assertions.statement: Per-production terminal order does not prove global letter-boundedness
assertions.evidence: S→aS|bS|ε generates Σ*; exact finite DFA-relation fixed point used for positive certificates

assertions.statement: Greedy decomposition can fail and empty bounded samples do not prove empty language
assertions.hypotheses: One sampled decomposition is not the whole exponent relation
assertions.evidence: word ab with bounds [a,ab] admits exponents (0,1); minimum word length can exceed sample limit

assertions.statement: aabacaabac is in the copied-block language and regular filter
assertions.evidence: IR oracle check in test_prompt_witnesses.py; replaced negative example with aabacabac
assertions.issue: Prompt supplied a positive word as a negative witness

assertions.statement: Grammar-filter49 is non-CFL by a regular slice and Ogden
assertions.hypotheses: Four nonempty blocks in chosen word, mark first b-block
assertions.evidence: THEORY.md §2.3 now uses i=2 uniformly, preserving block boundaries; equality equations force zero pumped marks

assertions.statement: w1w2w1w3 and wwvvR worked non-CFL reductions in THEORY.md remain supported by explicit decompositions and pumping
assertions.hypotheses: Exact alphabets/nonemptiness and chosen regular slices; binary alphabet for wwvvR
assertions.evidence: Root reviewed both inclusion arguments and all window cases; historical bounded checks not relabeled as new proofs

assertions.statement: A regular filter yields a CFL certificate only after validating its underlying CFG
assertions.hypotheses: Declared start/nonterminal/rule symbols; malformed expressions remain unknown
assertions.evidence: Independent Sol review reproduced invalid start and LHS certificates; root added five regressions before final core run

limits: No claim that every assertion in every historical report or every future LLM answer is proved
Ogden/interchange originals not read in full; exact statements checked in secondary slides
Parikh original 1966 not read in full; constructive primary reproof used
Python algorithms and IR translation are tested, not globally verified in Lean
Sampler candidate sets may ignore unsupported filter constraints; provenance is explicit and no full-language conclusion follows
